cot_history.reasoning_cot: No opponent code or traces are provided, so exploit immediate scarcity and desperation signals only. Bid low when supply likely covers many players, escalate sharply when my HP/no-water risk is high, and slightly overcut the strongest valid yesterday bid when scarcity suggests competition.

Cindy massively overbids regardless of need, Eric bids high but survivable, Bob/David are non-threats. I exploit this by conceding scarce days unless critical, then buying only when supply can cover me or my dehydration risk is high. I react only to yesterday’s top live bid and urgency.

Cindy is the only durable threat and overbids heavily; Bob/Eric are weak and often bust, David is inert. I conserve on high-supply days, bid just above Cindy’s yesterday bid when scarce or when I’m at risk, and spike only if no-water pressure is dangerous.

Exploit overspenders Cindy/David by conceding when supply is tight unless survival risk is high. Bob/Eric-like profiles crash budgets, so patience wins. Use only yesterday traces: bid pressure, supply scarcity, and whether opponents looked desperate. Bid low on abundant days, spike only when hp/no-water risk is acute or competition was moderate.

Cindy/Eric survived by persistently bidding ~149–159, far above sustainable salary flow; Bob/David are weak or dead. I exploit this by conserving on high-supply days and only contesting when low HP or scarce supply makes water critical, using yesterday’s bids to avoid pointless wars and outlast the overbidders.

Cindy overbids persistently (~135-149), David is moderate (~95), Bob is dead, Eric collapsed. I conserve against Cindy’s expensive pressure when safe, but jump above David/Cindy only in low supply or when my HP/no-water risk is high. Cindy and David massively overbid and preserve large budgets; Bob and Eric are weak or dead. I exploit this by bidding only when scarcity or my danger is real, using yesterday’s highest live bid as a cap signal. On safer days I underbid to conserve, letting reckless opponents burn budget while I survive efficiently.

I exploit by bidding low when supply likely covers two winners, but spike near their prior range when my HP/no-water risk is high or supply is tight.
